_help: Changes to the player's save, each made once (after a backup) when the mod is applied; playing on past them is never undone. The Save page in Clan Mod Studio writes this file for you (Keep it as a mod to share). By hand: paths start inside the save, Shared/... or 1/... for cat slot 1; "set" changes a value the save has, "add" adds keys to an object (an item to the inventory), "remove" takes keys out. docs/formats.md has the rest.
